test_nest_flatten: test nest.flatten to recursively flatten nested tuples, lists, and dicts into a flat list of leaf values
test_nest_map: test nest.map to apply a function to every leaf element in a nested structure while preserving shape
test_nest_pack_as: test nest.pack_as to reconstruct a nested structure from a flat list using a template structure
test_nest_map_many2: test nest.map_many2 to apply a two-argument function across corresponding leaves of two matching nested structures
test_nest_for_each: test nest.for_each to visit every leaf in a nested structure and apply a side-effecting function
